profile_text.body:
Groq, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Mountain View, describes itself as a neocloud focused on fast AI inference. The company offers what it calls a fully integrated platform covering infrastructure, inference, and control, and states that millions of developers run trillions of tokens on its systems every week.

The company's core product is its inference acceleration service, also named Groq. Its site notes a hardware component called LPX, which it describes as working alongside NVIDIA's next-generation GPUs to deliver inference capability at scale. Groq positions this combination as delivering reliability and affordability for large-scale inference workloads.

The site holds no information on litigation, MCP server listings, SEC filings, or patents connected to Groq at this time.
